div.div:
Fixed address
You can only have device with that address on the bus

div.div:
Configurable address
configured via HW
- Address pins
- Resistor straps
- Internal register (rare)
Examples:
- EEPROM with A0/A1/A2 pins
- PMBus device with ADDR pin
Allows multiple identical devices on the same bus
